name: pv_module_single_diode
title: PV module single-diode I-V curve
summary: Five-parameter single-diode model of a flat-plate PV module: module parameters read from an embedded PVModules catalogue table, I-V/P-V curve computed in 100 points at a given cell temperature and irradiance.

authors: W. De Soto, S. A. Klein, W. A. Beckman (original formulation, Solar Energy Laboratory UW-Madison)
origin.course: ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory course file (photovoltaique), derived from the UW F-Chart PV module model

verification.summary: Native file vs the EES stored solution: 333 common variables, 1 differs at rtol=0.001 (P[1], floating noise), max 1.37e-06 otherwise; the stored I-V parametric table matches exactly (300/300 within 1e-9).
verification.reference: EES stored solution (333 common variables) and the 100x3 I-V parametric table stored in the source file (hand-decoded from the binary)
verification.notes: 333 common variables, 1 differs (P[1]: EES -2.04506e-08 W vs 0, floating noise at V[1]=0); excluding it the largest relative deviation is 1.37e-06 (I[97]). I-V parametric table matches the stored solution exactly. Comparison made with the solution of the earlier runnable variant, which the native file reproduces in all common variables to 2.5e-6 (CoolSolve 0.3.0@4798e2b).

related_external: De Soto, Klein, Beckman, Improvement and validation of a model for photovoltaic array performance, Solar Energy 80 (2006) 78-88 (UW F-Chart PV model)
